ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: This is a simple math problem with no harm-adjacent or distasteful content, so the task-preference profiles (where both models are flat) don't differentiate them. The deciding factor is raw capability: Willet leads on every relevant benchmark—MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 54.3), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4)—margins well beyond run-to-run variance. For a reasoning task, the stronger model is the clear pick.
